newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI ELIMINATES NEW YORK IN EAST SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI ELIMINATES NEW YORK IN EAST SEMIFINALS.

text.p: The Miami Heat came back from
3-1 down in the series to beat the New York Knicks 101-90 on
Sunday to advance to the Eastern Conference finals.
Miami never trailed after the opening moments and led by
as many as 21 points before coasting home.
The Heat became the sixth team in playoff history to erase
a 3-1 deficit and win a series.
The defending champion Chicago Bulls will host the Heat on
Tuesday for the conference finals.
The Knicks contributed mightily to their own demise by
committing 21 turnovers on Sunday and by allowing three
players to be banned for Game Six and two for Sunday's game as
the result of a melee in Game Five.
The NBA banned forward P.J. Brown of the Heat for the last
two games.
Tim Hardaway scored a playoff career-high 38 points and
Alonzo Mourning added 22 for the Heat.
The Knicks Patrick Ewing, banned from Game Six, scored 37
points, after guaranteeing a New York victory on Sunday.
The sellout crowd at Miami Arena, which showered the
Knicks with debris at the end of Game Five, serenaded them
with a derisive "Goodbye" chant as time expired.
The 3-1 comeback was the first since 1995, when the
Houston Rockets rallied against the Phoenix Suns in the
Western Conference semifinals.
